_README: EXPECTED-RESULTS ORACLE. Every value below is transcribed from the DESK-FROZEN authority
docs/designs/ORACLE-AUTHORITY-ORPHAN-ZONES-2026-07-30.md and cites the section it came from.
NOTHING HERE IS COPIED FROM AN EMITTED PLAN. The authority derives its values from (Q1) a
1440-minute is_in_killzone() occupancy probe that reads NONE of the three tables under repair,
and (Q2) six semantic propositions P-1..P-6 that need no lane at all. That split is what makes
this an oracle rather than a third mirror: deleting a zone from REFUSED_SESSION_KEYWORDS does
not move a single number in the authority, so the table cannot game its own oracle.
IF AN OBSERVED VALUE DISAGREES WITH A ROW HERE, THAT IS A FINDING — FILE IT, DO NOT EDIT THE
ROW. Editing an expected value to match an output is HARDCODED TEST COPY IS A FABRICATED
SAFETY CLAIM. Only the desk amends the authority, by dated ruling, preserve-and-strike.
THREE ROWS ARE SHAPE-SPECIFIED, NOT STRING-SPECIFIED (authority section 5-5): the orphan
refusal reasons assert reason_names=<zone> (P-4 attribution), and the two unrecognized-
vocabulary reasons assert reason_excludes to stay DISTINCT from an orphan refusal. This repo
does not freeze a literal string the desk never derived.

40-overrefusal-boundary.spec.json._note: AXIS 3 — THE OVER-REFUSAL BOUNDARY (R-490 §3-1, ordered FIRST; the caption at spec-family-bindings.ts:258-260 promised these fixtures and R-490 §2 measured that ZERO existed). THE THREE confluence ROWS ARE THE PROBE: refused-zone keywords on NON-session families, which must bind NORMALLY. THE sess ROW IS THE POSITIVE CONTROL, carrying the SAME 'during lunch' text on WAIT_SESSION and refused. Both live in ONE fixture so the discrimination is adjacent: 'refuses the right thing' vs 'refuses anything mentioning lunch'. ★ WHAT THIS FIXTURE CANNOT DO, STATED HERE SO NO READER OVERCLAIMS IT: authority §6 does not adjudicate non-session families, so the probe rows carry NO correctness expectation. It therefore catches an over-refusal that appears in ONE lane (via CLAIM 1 drift) but is BLIND to an over-refusal appearing IDENTICALLY IN BOTH — the two-identically-wrong-lanes case. Closing that needs a DESK adjudication of the boundary, which is a desk request and not a builder decision (R-490 §5).
